name: Randek ZeroLabor robotic sub-assembly cell
summary: Robot cell that builds the slow hand-made parts of timber wall frames, such as U-studs, L-studs, double and triple studs, noggings and window and door rough openings, and buffers them on pallets for the main wall line. Launched by Randek at LIGNA 2025; runs stand-alone or feeding a line.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by Randek (Sweden) after a pre-study; Randek names Horn Hausbau Technologie as its representative for Germany, Austria and Switzerland. No price published.
germany.leadTime: Set per project in a pre-study (maker)

sellers.note: Randek's representative for Germany, Austria and Switzerland; no address or phone on the page.

notes: Robot count not published; at least one six-axis robot is shown, so arms is set to 1.
Includes a sub-assembly worktable and a reload station that feeds material into the cell.
Builds framing sub-components that go into the frame, not the whole wall frame.
